A purchase presents three distinct current states of the bound handbook with uniform integer weights and no replacement. All twelve current states remain candidates regardless of effect implementation coverage. Buying requires 100 fragments and remaining room-local purchase allowance; charge and count commit with the selected state's replacement/acquisition, not merely opening the offer. Cancel is free and retains the same sampled offer; no free reroll. Existing same-owner holdings may be replaced, including with the same state, resetting its allowance. Original Forge topology and Towat boss-card service are not implemented by this definition.
